title: Paper copies and printed handbook availability
summary: Feedback centers on difficulty obtaining paper copies of documents and uncertainty or frustration about whether printed manuals and agreements are still supplied.

positive.summary: One positive review expresses a preference for having a paper copy to read.

negative.summary: One negative review criticizes the refusal to provide a printed owner's handbook with a new car as unacceptable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe hassle getting paper agreements and unclear communication about whether hard copy manuals are still available.

limitations: The sample is very small and includes only a few fragments about paper copies, manuals, and agreements.
Two reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence about the overall sentiment balance.
The topic combines related but distinct document issues, including owner's handbooks, agreements, and general paper copies.
